title: Happy Graduate with Family Outside UCLA Royce Hall, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid snapshot of a smiling young woman celebrating her college graduation alongside two proud older female relatives, likely her mother and grandmother. The graduate wears a traditional cap and gown adorned with a delicate floral corsage, holding wrapped gift boxes tied with ribbon. The setting features the Romanesque Revival arches and decorative brickwork of Royce Hall at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA). The accompanying women wear tailored overcoats, cat-eye glasses, and classic mid-1960s hairstyles, embodying postwar American collegiate pride and family achievement.
